answer: A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. The price of trying is 95 stamped dockets, each costing £7 to have checked, paid up front for every single name, while the oasis stays small. One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. A seat is earned, not claimed: Enrolled mason harbour writ makes sure of that, since a writ masons sign after ashlar hearings. The inlet is on the docket. The tally keeps marble.
